records.title: Computable randomness under finite-ambiguity observations
records.provisional_shape: For every k>=1 let F_k be all total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps with at most k preimages of each point. R_fin(x) means x is computably random and F(x) is computably random for every k and F in F_k. Ask whether R_fin equals CR and, if not, for a natural characterization. No effective inverse branches are assumed.
records.motivation: Does bounded ambiguity of an observation explain stability beyond effective isomorphisms?
records.structural_difference: Restricts map fibres while keeping the ordinary computable-martingale observer; no distinct class is asserted.
records.prospective_value: Preservation or exact failure criterion, with a test characterization if a substantive class arises.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: may preserve CR outright or be covered by established map theory.
falsifiers: Already a routine instance of a recorded/source theorem
A known preservation class with no additional explanatory theorem
No substantive role for the finite-ambiguity restriction
dependencies: Effective inverse information versus cardinal fibre bounds
source_evidence_weaknesses: Catalogue does not evaluate bounded-fibre total maps; absence is not novelty evidence
Do not import an a.e.-map theorem into a total-map witness claim

formulation_alignment.map_scope: CAND-01 keeps everywhere-total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps. This is narrower in domain-totality than SRC-0015's a.e.-computable map convention, but no forward computable-randomness conservation theorem is inferred from that syntactic inclusion.
formulation_alignment.fibre_scope: For each fixed k>=1 the candidate requires the global cardinal condition |F^{-1}(y)|<=k for every y. This is retained as a set-theoretic fibre restriction. The candidate assumes no effective enumeration, selector or inverse branches for those fibres.
formulation_alignment.inverse_and_preimage_scope: THM-0038 assumes an a.e.-computable inverse pair with inverse identities almost everywhere; CAND-01 does not assume that data. THM-0037 instead concludes existence of at least one computably random preimage of a computably random output under an a.e.-computable map. That existential reverse-direction conclusion is not forward preservation of computable randomness.
formulation_alignment.maximality_guard: THM-0008 and THM-0039 concern Martin-Löf randomness and closure under conservation plus no-randomness-from-nothing. They do not supply a finite-to-one computable-randomness preservation theorem for CAND-01.
formulation_alignment.evidence: The committed catalogue was sufficient. SRC-0011/SRC-0015 are already STATEMENT_INSPECTED and the exact hypotheses are recorded in DEF-0035/DEF-0036 and THM-0035/THM-0037/THM-0038/THM-0008/THM-0039. No source passage was reopened and no access level changed.
formulation_alignment.conclusion: The exact CAND-01 formulation is not disposed of by the recorded map/isomorphism/preimage theorems. Retain it provisionally with shape unchanged and mark E1 resolved. This is not evidence of novelty, openness, separation or nontriviality, and no finite-to-one preservation theorem is asserted.

prior_art_summary.total_map_counterexample: SRC-0061 / THM-0072: total truth-table fair-coin-preserving maps can destroy computable randomness without any recorded finite-fibre bound
prior_art_summary.live_discriminator: fixed global finite cardinal fibre bound with no effective inverse branches
prior_art_summary.conclusion: Exact CAND-01 status remains unresolved under the inspected primary evidence.

significance_assessment.judgment: The fixed global finite-fibre restriction is a mathematically recognized structural axis rather than an obviously cosmetic patch, but its bare cardinal form is not yet shown to have any computable-randomness consequence. Continued investment is justified only conditionally.
significance_assessment.internal_boundary: The restriction is the surviving discriminator between known failure under unrestricted total fair-coin-preserving maps and known positive invariance under maps with explicit effective inverse data.
literature_support: SRC-0065: uniformly finite-to-one endomorphisms carry nontrivial entropy/conjugacy structure under stronger dynamical hypotheses.
SRC-0066: finite-to-one factor codes and their degree/encoding constraints are substantive in symbolic dynamics and connect to deterministic-channel questions under stronger shift structure.
usefulness_conditions: A sharp preservation or failure theorem for computable randomness under the exact globally k-to-one total fair-coin-preserving class.
An explanatory mechanism or intrinsic characterization showing what bounded ambiguity changes for effective betting/tests, without silently adding effective inverse branches.
A sharp boundary result separating bare cardinal finite fibres from effective isomorphism/inverse information and from unrestricted total-map counterexamples.
If a proper robustness class R_fin emerges, an intrinsic characterization and nontrivial comparison with established randomness notions.
Quantitative information-loss or coding consequences only if proved under the exact effective hypotheses; no O(log k) or similar bound is presumed.

likely_interested_communities.interest: core: exact question concerns computable randomness and computable measure-preserving transformations
core-adjacent: total versus a.e.-computable maps and effective measure morphisms are central conventions
plausible only if the result links the bare effective problem to established finite-to-one endomorphism or factor-code structure
plausible only if a theorem yields a real coding, channel or quantitative information-loss consequence

future_theorem_package: Main exact preservation theorem or a sharp counterexample at finite multiplicity.
Structural characterization or transfer principle explaining the role of bounded ambiguity.
Sharpness/boundary theorem against effective inverse/isomorphism hypotheses and unrestricted non-conservation.
Natural examples/subclasses linking the abstract Cantor formulation to recognizable dynamics; if R_fin is proper, characterize it intrinsically.
Optional quantitative information consequence only after the exact hypotheses support it.
significance_assessment.continuation_falsifier: If the eventual result is a routine adaptation with no explanatory characterization, or the finite-fibre condition plays no essential role, the significance case collapses even if the yes/no question has a technically correct answer.
significance_assessment.novelty_guard: This is a significance/usefulness judgment only. CAND-01 remains UNRESOLVED_UNDER_INSPECTED_EVIDENCE for novelty/prior art; no theorem, openness, distinctness or publishability claim is made.

selection_readiness.principal_risk: Finite cardinal multiplicity is provisionally substantive but has no established computable-randomness consequence.

selection_decision.rationale: Preferred Phase-4 investment profile: structurally meaningful finite-multiplicity axis with explanatory theorem package, while preserving the unresolved fact that no computable-randomness consequence is established.

gate3_review.guard: Finite multiplicity is provisionally substantive but has no established computable-randomness consequence.

new_programme_mathematics: Fair-coin preservation plus injectivity forces surjectivity because the range is closed and every nonempty cylinder has positive fair-coin measure.
Total computability plus injectivity on compact Cantor space yields an everywhere-total computable inverse with a computable map-dependent inverse-use modulus.
No single inverse-use bound works uniformly across all k=1 maps; coordinate permutations witness arbitrarily delayed inverse use.
phase4_mathematics.literature_dependency: SRC-0015 / THM-0038 supplies computable-randomness invariance once the effective inverse pair is established.

k2_loss_level_searchability_result.obstruction: Halting-time information can be carried by summably small positive heartbeat losses; event frequency does not control reachable loss scale.
k2_loss_level_searchability_result.loss_bar_searchability_equivalence: witness modulus <=> decidable Reach(K,m) <=> uniform positive semidecidability of true Bar(K,m)
k2_loss_level_searchability_result.next_question: scale-tail local data versus shrinking-scale halting obstruction

forced_information: Uniform descending computable clopen sets F^{-1}([y↾m]) intersect exactly to the fibre.
A chosen fibre point is computable from y once an isolating input prefix is supplied.
nonforced_information: Two everywhere-total computable branches enumerating every fibre.
phase4_k2_mathematics.counterexample_boundary: A prefix-replacement map with exactly one double fibre has no continuous global selector/listing, yet has an a.e.-computable measure-preserving inverse and therefore preserves computable randomness by SRC-0015 / THM-0038.
phase4_k2_mathematics.second_positive_boundary: The exactly two-to-one left shift preserves computable randomness by direct martingale lift.

phase4_k2_transfer_mathematics.scope: k=2 weighted-sheet and martingale-transfer boundary only
forced_information: For every input precision n, a computable output precision yields at most two candidate n-prefixes for each fibre.
For every input cylinder [sigma], the relative masses w_sigma(tau)=2^{|tau|} lambda([sigma]∩F^{-1}([tau])) form a uniformly computable bounded fair martingale.
phase4_k2_transfer_mathematics.sufficient_positive_mechanism: A computable clopen partition into two injective sheets yields component effective isomorphisms; SRC-0015 / THM-0038 plus DEF-0036 gives forward fair-coin computable-randomness preservation.
phase4_k2_transfer_mathematics.nonforced_information: A global continuous/computable clopen two-sheet colouring; the marker-and-delete k=2 map refutes this.
phase4_k2_transfer_mathematics.failed_counterexample_route: Completing SRC-0061's nonmonotonic scan with filler queries can pre-reveal later betting positions; no winning ordinary output martingale was preserved while maintaining the global k=2 fibre bound.

successful_mechanisms: Low conditional sheet weight pulls back to a uniformly effectively open source set with measure at most the threshold.
Every fixed output martingale stage lifts exactly to a normalized computable source martingale.
An exact asymmetric collision map satisfies all k=2 map hypotheses while one genuine sheet has conditional weight tending to zero.
phase4_k2_weight_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No computable hitting probability/stopped pullback or single coherent source martingale is forced by the established two-prefix data.

successful_mechanisms: Exact k=2 halting-triggered prefix-code map with a noncomputable low-weight crossing measure.
The counterexample retains a computable clopen injective two-sheet split, so it separates stopping-effectivity failure from actual non-conservation.
The natural inverse-point-count lift can have noncomputable total mass even for fair-coin output measure.
phase4_k2_stopping_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No single coherent computable pullback martingale and no exact k=2 computable-randomness destroyer were obtained.

phase4_k2_canonical_sheet_mathematics.scope: k=2 canonical lexicographic sheet / one-hole boundary only
successful_mechanisms: Collision relation is effectively closed; canonical upper/lower sheets are effective F-sigma/G-delta.
Lexicographic min/max inverse selectors are effective Baire-1 limits of computable continuous approximants.
The P4-S005 internal map gives noncomputable canonical sheet masses, blocking uniform computable component measures.
A one-hole/rotating-mask filler architecture collapses when a masked genuine betting coordinate is revealed.
phase4_k2_canonical_sheet_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No computable component measure, stabilization modulus, coherent source martingale or exact k=2 destroyer is obtained; delayed-coalescence constructions remain untested.

successful_mechanisms: A computable monotone c(n) yields coherent compatible-prefix levels of width at most two whose paths are exactly the fibre.
Double fibres become exact two-track skeletons after their first true split; singleton phantoms must move their disagreement arbitrarily far right.
At fixed source precision there is a computable mind-change bound and at most one post-coalescence injury.
Singleton fibres admit a uniform partial inverse procedure under the singleton promise.
Post-coalescence first-n ambiguity is one binary cohort, yielding an architecture-independent collapse lemma and a necessary freshness condition for scan completions.
phase4_k2_delayed_coalescence_mathematic.unresolved_mechanism: No computable last-injury time, branch mass, coherent source martingale or exact k=2 destroyer is obtained. SRC-0061 supplies no proved freshness schedule relative to c(n).

phase4_k2_freshness_mathematics.scope: k=2 adaptive no-repeat scan freshness / permutation-completion boundary only
successful_mechanisms: P4-S007's c(n) means every scan transcript has queried at least n-1 of the first n source coordinates by stage c(n).
For each fixed coordinate j, prequerying j and then following the scan until it requests j yields a total computable adaptive permutation completion.
A martingale can copy the original output martingale along that completion and freeze at sentinel consumption; therefore a computably random winning source cannot omit any fixed coordinate.
Any possible scan-based k=2 destroyer is reduced to a singleton fibre whose unique low-coordinate hole, when present, moves outward and is eventually consumed.
phase4_k2_freshness_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: On a singleton winning path every fixed sentinel is eventually consumed. No computable relation between output-capital growth and sentinel query time is forced, and no dynamic-sentinel scheme is proved globally exhaustive without pre-revealing later genuine bets.

phase4_k2_moving_hole_mathematics.scope: k=2 singleton moving-hole / dynamic-sentinel boundary only
successful_mechanisms: For any finite scan state and fresh sentinel, the avoidance continuations form a computable binary tree; uniform eventual consumption yields a computably searchable finite deadline.
Given a finite deadline, finite conditional expectation exactly hedges the deferred logical wager on a sentinel revealed early, with no multiplicative turnover loss.
Any genuinely unbounded singleton turnover is target-consumed but omittable on a sibling continuation.
Finite-horizon portfolio/savings accounting has vanishing tail coverage and yields no rate-free infinite-turnover lower bound from output-martingale unboundedness alone.
A simple global k=2 fair-coin singleton-spine comb verifies the query-set geometry but not a computably random witness.
phase4_k2_moving_hole_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No computable unbounded deferred-wager value, no rate-free dynamic-sentinel transfer, and no exact adaptive singleton-spine destroyer were obtained.

phase4_k2_optional_projection_mathematic.scope: k=2 branchwise-avoidable capped optional-projection / adaptive singleton-spine boundary only
successful_mechanisms: A global k=2 scan can encode a noncomputable left-c.e. sentinel-consumption probability.
A cap-2 bounded martingale can have exact deferred-payoff projection values 1-alpha and 1+alpha, so threshold capping does not force a computable optional projection.
Finite-horizon projections can lack a computable convergence modulus.
An adaptive least-unqueried-sentinel comb passes totality, fair-coin, fibre, singleton-spine, freshness and non-pre-revelation checks.
phase4_k2_optional_projection_mathematic.unresolved_mechanism: No computably random all-trigger correct-prediction source is proved, and no exact k=2 destroyer or full scan-preservation theorem is obtained.

phase4_k2_autoreduction_spine_mathematic.scope: k=2 adaptive c.e.-trigger singleton-spine source-randomness question only

phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.scope: k=2 partial-predictor / singleton-scan converse boundary only
phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.scan_converse: Every computably-random winning global-k=2 no-repeat scan induces a self-avoiding stake functional total on the winning source which reproduces the output martingale in the original query order.
phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.all_in_special_case: Every all-in wager on a succeeding path is correct.
phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.next_boundary: effective sibling totality / uniform deadline sufficient for least-fresh preservation

phase4_k2_sibling_totality_mathematics.scope: k=2 sibling-totality / finite-deadline boundary inside least-fresh scan subclass only
phase4_k2_sibling_totality_mathematics.weakest_established_condition: reachable-sentinel totality, equivalently no infinite reachable avoidance branch / computably searchable finite deadline
phase4_k2_sibling_totality_mathematics.next_boundary: computable summable avoidance-tail control weaker than finite deadlines

phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.scope: k=2 computably budgeted finite-horizon avoidance tails inside least-fresh stake subclass only
phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.weakest_established_summability_conditio: A total computable horizon selector H(s) and one finite computable uniform pathwise bound on the sum of the exact conditional horizon-miss probabilities p(s) over all reached epoch states.
phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.stronger_easy_form: A computable summable epoch sequence epsilon_r uniformly bounding every reachable r-th epoch miss probability.
phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.strict_separation_from_p4_s013: Zero-stake wait-for-next-1 functional has an infinite all-zero avoiding sibling at each reached epoch while H_r=r+2 gives total miss budget <=1/2.
phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.next_boundary: stake-weighted skipped-wager loss budgets with nonsummable raw miss probabilities

phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.scope: k=2 stake-weighted skipped-wager loss boundary inside least-fresh stake subclass only
phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.exact_weighted_price: 2^{-(H(s)+1)} times the sum over miss leaves of the two sentinel-bit future-loss envelopes
phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.coarse_condition: sum p(s)a(s) finite when a(s) computably bounds possible positive post-horizon sentinel gain
phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.strict_separation_from_p4_s014: Two-control-bit scan has permanent avoidance probability 1/4 at every epoch, hence no raw-tail certificate for any horizon selector, while small sentinel stakes have weighted budget at most 1/4.
phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.next_boundary: incremental loss tickets without an advance future-loss envelope

phase4_k2_incremental_ticket_mathematics.scope: k=2 envelope-free incremental postmiss loss-ticket boundary only
successful_mechanisms: Exact immediate skipped-gain losses for both next filler children are computable from each finite unresolved postmiss state.
Their average is the exact fair price of a last-chance one-step loss ticket.
A finite uniform pathwise sum budget on these automatic prices plus the P4-S015 restart hedge yields one source transfer martingale.
P4-S011 necessarily has divergent premium sum on its target for every computable horizon selector.
phase4_k2_incremental_ticket_mathematics.relation_to_p4_s015: effectivity envelope removed; complete numerical certificate conditions not claimed ordered
phase4_k2_incremental_ticket_mathematics.next_question: self-financing premium reserve versus absolute premium-sum budget

phase4_k2_self_financing_reserve_mathema.scope: k=2 self-financing last-chance reserve boundary only
successful_mechanisms: Earlier exact-ticket payouts may fund later exact fair premiums.
Global no-overdraft plus unbounded ticket capital whenever realized positive skipped gain diverges is sufficient with the settled restart hedge.
P4-S016 absolute premium summability implies the new condition.
A fixed-H example has harmonic premium expenditure but a finite reserve that grows from ticket winnings.
Bare no-overdraft is insufficient: certain-payout tickets can recycle capital while realized loss diverges and the restart hedge stagnates.
P4-S011 admits no coercive self-financing certificate for any computable horizon selector.
phase4_k2_self_financing_reserve_mathema.next_boundary: local computable reserve-floor / retained-surplus modulus versus semantic coercivity

successful_mechanisms: A computable h(K) with E(v)>=h(K) => W*(v)>=K yields the same ticket/restart source transfer.
The P4-S017 fixed-H one-sided-trigger stream has such a modulus despite divergent harmonic premiums.
A mode-switched exact k=2 stream has semantic coercivity while finite side bursts reach arbitrarily large E at bounded capital, so no uniform threshold exists even noncomputably.
The exact set-theoretic strengthening is loss-properness b(K)=sup{E(v):W*(v)<K}<infinity.
P4-S011 has no effective coercivity modulus for any computable H.
phase4_k2_effective_coercivity_mathemati.next_boundary: finite loss-properness versus computable upper bounds on b(K)

successful_mechanisms: The bad-capital loss height b(K) is uniformly lower semicomputable from the computable ticket tree.
A globally admissible exact k=2 halting-coded ticket stream has b(K)<infinity for every K but no computable majorant.
Effective loss-properness, a computable uniform upper bound on b(K), is equivalent up to a margin to the P4-S018 coercivity modulus.
P4-S011 cannot be loss-proper under global admissibility.
phase4_k2_loss_properness_effectivity_ma.obstruction: finite bad-capital excursions can encode unbounded halting times after zero-loss waiting
phase4_k2_loss_properness_effectivity_ma.next_boundary: structural conditions making finite loss bars effectively searchable

phase4_k2_loss_level_searchability_mathe.scope: k=2 loss-properness zero-loss-waiting / searchable-loss-level boundary only
successful_mechanisms: P4-S019 can be heartbeatized with summably small positive deterministic losses, preserving finite b(K) and destroying every computable majorant despite a fixed next-positive-loss waiting bound.
A computable D(K,m) bounding one witness depth whenever bad-capital loss level m is reachable makes Reach(K,m) decidable by finite search.
Under loss-properness, searching for the first unreachable integer loss level yields a total computable U(K) and hence the P4-S018 coercivity modulus.
A stronger branchwise amount-sensitive progress modulus implies the witness condition, but root-level witness searchability does not constrain slow sibling branches.
The settled harmonic one-sided-trigger account has searchable loss levels while absolute premium sum diverges.
phase4_k2_loss_level_searchability_mathe.obstruction: Loss-scale nonuniformity: halting information can hide across infinitely many summably small positive increments rather than zero-loss waiting.

phase4_k2_scale_tail_mathematics.scope: k=2 loss-scale / scale-tail effectivity boundary only
successful_mechanisms: A computable waiting bound for reachable losses at least 2^-n gives finite-search decidability of coarse-scale accumulated-loss reachability.
Under set-theoretic loss-properness, an unreachable coarse-scale amount plus a computable bound on smaller realized losses yields a computable U(K).
The settled harmonic one-sided-trigger account satisfies scale-tail control while absolute premium sum diverges.

A globally k=2, globally admissible geometric-tail construction has global fixed-scale deadlines, effectively vanishing small-loss tails and a computable linear U(K), yet Reach(e+2,2e+2) is equivalent to machine-e halting.
P4-S011 has divergent realized loss in arbitrarily small scales under global admissibility, so every finite subscale-tail certificate fails on its computably random target.
phase4_k2_scale_tail_mathematics.obstruction: Finite attainment versus limit approach at an exact loss boundary can encode halting despite effective control of total loss mass.

successful_mechanisms: P4-S021 effective loss bounds plus fixed-scale waiting yield a computable global exhaustion frontier for every loss scale.
At an exhausted scale, a computable residual subscale cap gives a finitely checkable strict certificate that a queried integer boundary cannot be reached.
If every false Reach(K,m) instance eventually receives such a strict frontier certificate, dovetailing it with ordinary finite witness search decides exact Reach.
A separate bounded-crossing arm is unnecessary because true Reach already has c.e. finite witnesses.
Any resulting Reach decision procedure compiles to the P4-S020 witness modulus, so the new condition is only weaker as primitive local data, not final computability strength.
The P4-S021 geometric nonhalting branch keeps the exact residual tail equal to the current boundary gap, showing nonstrict E+Q<=m control is insufficient.
P4-S011 fails the underlying P4-S021 subscale-tail hypothesis under global admissibility.
phase4_k2_boundary_isolation_mathematics.obstruction: The only surviving one-branch shrinking-scale obstruction is equality at a nonattained boundary: strict residual separation never appears although the computable tail tends to zero.

phase4_k2_semantic_anti_zeno_mathematics.scope: k=2 semantic anti-Zeno / effective-compactness boundary only
successful_mechanisms: Strong P4-S021 global scale exhaustion plus an effectively vanishing subscale tail makes cumulative loss uniformly Cauchy on each bad-capital branch space.
The branch-limit loss is continuous on the compact bad-capital path space.

If false Reach(K,m) had no strict P4-S022 frontier certificate, near-boundary frontier nodes at finer scales would compactify to a branch whose loss converges to m from below without finite attainment.
Semantic anti-Zeno rules out that branch, so a strict frontier certificate is searchable and exact Reach is decidable.
P4-S020's witness modulus is recoverable from the resulting Reach decision.
P4-S011 fails the strong tail hypothesis under global admissibility.
phase4_k2_semantic_anti_zeno_mathematics.next_obstruction: Whether uniform effective tail convergence can be weakened to pointwise or branchwise effective convergence.

positive_boundary: A single oracle-uniform branchwise Cauchy-modulus functional total on all bad-capital branches yields a computable global uniform tail modulus by effective compactness.
Under semantic anti-Zeno this recovered uniformity gives searchable strict frontier separation and decidable Reach exactly as in P4-S023.
negative_boundary: An exact computable globally k=2, globally admissible comb has every individual bad-capital branch eventually loss-constant and hence branchwise effectively convergent and non-Zeno.
The comb retains computable global exhaustion of every fixed positive loss scale and an explicit computable bad-capital loss bound.
Reach(e+2,2e+2) holds exactly when machine e halts.
Near-boundary tooth limits converge to the queried boundary while the Cantor-limit spine remains two units below it, so the branch-limit loss is discontinuous.

phase4_k2_effective_upper_semicontinuity.scope: k=2 effective upper-semicontinuity / local tail-cap boundary only
positive_boundary: A complete c.e. sound local upper-cap basis for branch-limit loss yields a computable global uniform tail modulus by effective compactness of the pruned bad-capital tree.
Conversely a computable global uniform tail modulus enumerates a complete effective upper-cap basis.
With semantic anti-Zeno, either presentation forces searchable strict frontier separation, decidable Reach(K,m), and recovery of the P4-S020 witness modulus.
negative_boundary: An exact computable globally k=2, globally admissible delayed-activation comb has continuous branch-limit loss and every bad-capital branch eventually loss-constant and non-Zeno.
The comb retains computable global exhaustion of every fixed positive loss scale and an explicit computable bad-capital loss bound.
Reach(e+2,2e+2) holds exactly when machine e halts, so ordinary continuity does not make the strict gap effectively searchable.
The missing datum is a computable upper-cap/continuity modulus; full effective upper-semicontinuity would decide the halting-coded Reach instances.

phase4_k2_boundary_cap_mathematics.scope: k=2 one-sided integer-boundary cap / completeness-collapse only
positive_boundary: A c.e. sound local certificate basis for the strict integer sublevel L_K<m semidecides true Bar under semantic anti-Zeno by effective compactness.
Reach already has c.e. finite witnesses; dovetailing yields decidable Reach and the P4-S020 witness modulus.
Oracle-uniform local integer-clearance functionals compile into the same c.e. boundary-certificate system.
On the anti-Zeno promised class, a Bar semidecision yields a degenerate root boundary certificate, so abstract boundary completeness has exactly the missing negative-search content.
representation_separation: A computable globally admissible exhaustive k=2 deterministic-ticket stream can have constant noncomputable left-c.e. branch-limit loss alpha<1/4.
Every integer boundary then has the trivial root cap 1/4, while a complete rational upper-cap basis would make alpha computable.

records.title: Nonergodic convergence for enumerable events
records.object: individual sequence; dynamics and effectively open events
records.provisional_shape: B_open(x) means that for every total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-map T and every effectively open U, the averages (1/N) sum_{i<N} 1_U(T^i x) converge. No ergodicity, expectation equality, computable event measure or convergence modulus is required. Ask for its exact randomness characterization.
records.motivation: Identify the randomness needed for convergent frequencies of positively recognizable binary events in nonergodic dynamics.
records.structural_difference: Changes the observable from computable to enumerable-event indicators; boundedness isolates recognition from integrability-tail issues.
records.prospective_value: Exact test characterization or substantive obstruction; explain the relation to the larger lower-semicomputable observable class.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: familiar endpoint, existing characterization, or a transformation-convention artifact.
falsifiers: Exact source already characterizes this same map/observable class
Apparent gap is solely total versus a.e. maps or convergence versus expectation
No substantive characterization beyond existing endpoints
source_evidence_weaknesses: SRC-0058 total versus a.e. transformation convention requires local alignment before applying its converse
The absent indicator converse in this bounded catalogue is not an open-problem claim

formulation_alignment.transformation_scope: CAND-02 keeps everywhere-total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps. SRC-0058's computable-transformation representation guarantees the induced transformation is defined and infinite outside a computable G_delta null set; its Section 4 converse construction explicitly ensures definition almost everywhere, not everywhere totality.
formulation_alignment.observable_scope: CAND-02 keeps indicators of effectively open sets. These are bounded lower-semicomputable observables, so they sit inside the lower-semicomputable observable convention used for THM-0064 without importing unbounded/integrability-tail issues. THM-0063's converse witness uses a computable set/indicator, but its transformation is only source-a.e.-defined.
formulation_alignment.nonergodic_guard: CAND-02 requires convergence only. No equality with lambda(U) is required. THM-0059/THM-0060 identify the limit with the expectation only under ergodicity and are retained solely as that guard.
formulation_alignment.evidence: SRC-0058 was locally reinspected at the smallest blocking passages in the already-catalogued arXiv copy: Definition 1.4, Section 2 transformation representation, Section 4 converse construction, and Section 5 lower-semicomputable theorem. formulation_alignment.conclusion: The exact CAND-02 predicate is not disposed of by THM-0063 because the source converse witness is not established everywhere total. THM-0064 remains a sufficient-condition benchmark, not a characterization of the candidate predicate. No converse, separation, novelty or literature-openness claim is made.

records.title: Oracle lowness for uniform computable randomness
records.object: oracle class, not a sampled-sequence randomness class
records.provisional_shape: L_u consists of those A such that every computably random X is computably random uniformly relative to A in DEF-0025. Uniform families must be total and valid on every oracle instance. Ask for an intrinsic characterization and comparison with computable oracles and K-triviality, without asserting any answer.
records.motivation: Determine whether the known pairwise ordinary/uniform relativization distinction survives universal preservation over random inputs.
records.structural_difference: Universal lowness with globally total uniform families; neither ordinary lowness nor existential baseness by definition.
records.prospective_value: Independent oracle characterization with a concrete randomness or product-information consequence.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: universal quantification may erase the distinction; a standard lowness class may already characterize it.
falsifiers: Established lowness class with its existing characterization
Routine reduction to ordinary computable lowness
No meaningful consequence for randomness beyond renaming an oracle property
source_evidence_weaknesses: Broader uniform-lowness and traceability literature was deliberately not catalogued
THM-0025 supplies an existential pair only, not a noncomputable member of L_u
SRC-0009 Theorem 5.7 is a statement-inspected source-record contrast, not a separate THM node

formulation_alignment.universal_lowness_scope: CAND-03 keeps L_u = {A : for every unrelativized computably random X, X is computably random uniformly relative to A}. This is a universal preservation condition over all X in CR for a fixed oracle A; a single pairwise ordinary/uniform separation does not witness membership in L_u.
formulation_alignment.uniform_family_scope: DEF-0025 / SRC-0032 use a total computable map coding a uniform family whose every oracle instance is a valid martingale. The candidate keeps that global all-oracle totality/validity convention. A procedure total or valid only at the chosen A is excluded.
formulation_alignment.pairwise_guard: THM-0024 is a symmetric pairwise join characterization and THM-0025 is an existential pairwise separation. Neither theorem has the universal lowness quantifier over every unrelativized computably random X, and neither supplies a noncomputable member of L_u.
formulation_alignment.lowness_base_guard: DEF-0007 is universal lowness for ordinary oracle-relative Martin-Löf randomness; DEF-0009 is existential baseness. THM-0003/THM-0069/THM-0070 and THM-0004 connect those ML/K notions under their recorded hypotheses only. SRC-0009 Theorem 5.7 is retained as a contrast about ordinary computable-randomness lowness, not transferred to the DEF-0025 uniform-family setting.
formulation_alignment.independent_value_criterion: Future promotion requires an intrinsic computability-theoretic characterization of L_u that is independent of merely restating the universal preservation clause, together with a concrete consequence for randomness or product/information behaviour. Mere renaming of an established lowness class, a routine reduction to ordinary computable lowness, or no meaningful randomness consequence is a falsifier.
formulation_alignment.evidence: The committed catalogue was sufficient. DEF-0025/SRC-0032/THM-0024/THM-0025 and the recorded lowness/base definitions and theorems are already STATEMENT_INSPECTED at the relevant scope. No source passage was reopened and no access level or catalogue record changed.
formulation_alignment.conclusion: The recorded anchors do not dispose of the exact CAND-03 formulation. Retain it provisionally as an auxiliary direction with shape unchanged and mark E3 resolved. This is not evidence of novelty, openness, a noncomputable low oracle, equivalence to K-triviality, collapse to computable oracles or mathematical nontriviality.

prior_art_summary.closest_framework: SRC-0064 / DEF-0065: parameterized uniform-lowness class Low^star(C,D)
prior_art_summary.exact_definition_level_match: CAND-03 L_u is Low^star(CR,CR) when uniformly relative computable randomness is DEF-0025 / SRC-0032.
prior_art_summary.ordinary_relativization_guard: SRC-0009 / THM-0075 characterizes ordinary low-for-computable-randomness only and is not transferred to the uniform-family class.
prior_art_summary.unresolved_remainder: No inspected primary statement characterized the specific Low^star(CR,CR) instance intrinsically; that characterization question remains unresolved under inspected evidence.
prior_art_summary.conclusion: CAND-03 is retired as a candidate for a new named notion because its exact oracle-class definition is existing Low^star(CR,CR) prior art. The specific characterization of that instance is not settled here.
